note: Rustic Manistee NF campground adjoining Seaton Creek at the upper end of the Hodenpyl Dam backwater of the Big Manistee River, in mostly pine forest near a picnic area. Connector trail to the Manistee River Trail; the North Country Trail is across the suspension bridge over the Manistee. Kayakers can come up the very shallow Seaton Creek. Reached from M-37 by 26 Road, O'Rourke Drive and Forest Road 5993. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov + RIDB catalog: $30 single (confirmed, 2026 and 2027), 19 sites = 17 family (13 pull-through) + 2 group (confirmed), vault toilets and potable water (new), season late April - early October (new, year_round false; no exact dates). Booking changed reservable true -> false, fcfs always: the 17 family sites are first-come and only the group sites book on recreation.gov (README rule: group sites alone don't count). Senior/Access 50% stated. No electric (catalog, left). The FS page shows 'Site Closed' (seasonal: the season ends early October).
